mode.title: Read-only or read-write?
mode.description: **Read-only (recommended first):** reads your inverter and shows, on the device page, exactly what the schedule WOULD change. Nothing is ever written. Use this to check the plan against your tariff before trusting it.\n\n**Read-write:** every 10 minutes the integration changes your inverter's AC-charge windows, AC First windows, charge limits and AC charge power to match the plan. You can switch between the two later with the 'Read-only mode' switch.

confirm.title: Confirm read-write
confirm.description: This will modify settings on your inverter. Make sure no other automation or tool is writing the same registers (AC charge windows, AC First windows, AC charge start/end SOC, AC charge power). There is no warranty.
